name: XCC_ESSBASE_REPORTING_TREES
description: This table contains the tree versions copied to  Oracle Fusion Budgetary Control Essbase cubes solely for reporting purposes.

columns.name: SEGMENT_CODE
columns.description: Code of the chart of accounts segment.

columns.name: VALUE_SET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a value set that validates the segment values in a chart of accounts segment.

columns.name: TREE_STRUCTURE_CODE
columns.description: Tree structure code associated with a segment value set.

columns.name: TREE_CODE
columns.description: Tree code oassociated with a segment value set.

columns.name: TREE_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the tree version that captures the hierarchical relationship among the chart of accounts segment values.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.
